verdict.rationale: The product officially supports Docker self-hosting, and a release note about pointing k8s probes at /api/ping implies first-party Kubernetes deployment artifacts. The pack contains no actual deployment guides, and nothing for Helm, VPS, or Raspberry Pi. missing for 10: dedicated maintained Docker Compose guide, documented Kubernetes/Helm guide or chart, small-VPS guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, independent hands-on corroboration of these deployment paths

support.subject: As a self-hoster, official deployment paths cover my target — Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, a small VPS, or a Raspberry Pi — each with its own maintained guide

citations.quote: fix: point k8s probes at the server's /api/ping
